problem.question: Lena has 16 candy bars. She needs 5 more candy bars to have 3 times as many as Kevin, and Kevin has 4 candy bars less than Nicole. How many more candy bars does Lena have than Nicole?
problem.answer:
Kevin has (16 + 5)/3 = <<(16+5)/3=7>>7 candy bars.
Nicole has 7 + 4 = <<7+4=11>>11 candy bars.
Lena has 16 - 11 = <<16-11=5>>5 more candy bars than Nicole
